name: tensions
character: Tension is a mechanism, not an adjective. Each entry names the one device that creates it and what it must NOT resolve into, so a cue asked for tension gets a device a listener's ear already reads as unresolved.

pedal.character: one pitch held under everything while the harmony moves over it
pedal.device: a drone or pedal tone at the tonic or dominant, held through two or more chord changes
pedal.resolves_by: the pedal stops being the bass and the bass moves

ostinato.character: the same cell again and again; the ear starts counting and cannot stop
ostinato.device: a short repeating figure, identical in pitch, with only velocity moving

tritone.character: diabolus in musica: the interval that refuses to sound finished
tritone.device: an augmented fourth sounding against a held note, or two voices a tritone apart
tritone.resolves_by: one of the two voices moves a semitone

cluster.character: too many notes too close; the ear cannot separate them
cluster.device: seconds stacked in one register, held
cluster.resolves_by: the cluster thins to an interval

silence_before.character: the room goes quiet and the audience leans in
silence_before.device: a gap of at least a bar before the event, with no bed carrying through it

unresolved_dominant.character: a question mark at the end of the sentence
unresolved_dominant.device: ending on the dominant or on a suspended chord, with the tonic never sounding last
unresolved_dominant.resolves_by: the tonic finally lands, usually in the next cue

rising_line.character: something is climbing and the audience does not know where
rising_line.device: a line that rises by step across the cue without arriving at a stable pitch

static_high.character: a thin high tone that will not go away
static_high.device: one high pitch, barely moving, present under the whole cue

provenance.tensions.*.qa: starting value: a floor a mechanism has to reach before it is audible as that mechanism, uncalibrated
provenance.tensions.*.forbidden: the gesture that would resolve the tension early; taken from the same section-3 table that names each device
